lineRateQuery: select f.status,f.document_type,i.vat_rate,count(*) as line_count,coalesce(sum(i.vat_base),0) as stored_vat_base,coalesce(sum(i.tax_amount),0) as stored_tax_amount from public.shared_inventory_purchase_invoices f join public.shared_inventory_purchase_invoice_items i on i.tenant_id=f.tenant_id and i.invoice_id=f.id where f.status='confirmada' group by f.status,f.document_type,i.vat_rate order by f.document_type,i.vat_rate
headerLineComparisonQuery: with line_totals as (select i.tenant_id,i.invoice_id,count(*) as line_count,coalesce(sum(i.tax_amount),0) as line_tax from public.shared_inventory_purchase_invoice_items i group by i.tenant_id,i.invoice_id) select f.status,f.document_type,count(*) as document_count,count(*) filter (where l.invoice_id is null) as missing_line_documents,count(*) filter (where l.invoice_id is not null and abs(coalesce(f.vat_amount,0)-l.line_tax)>0.01) as header_line_tax_mismatch_count,coalesce(sum(f.vat_amount),0) as header_tax_total,coalesce(sum(l.line_tax),0) as line_tax_total,count(*) filter (where coalesce(f.vat_retention_amount,0)>0) as positive_retention_documents from public.shared_inventory_purchase_invoices f left join line_totals l on l.tenant_id=f.tenant_id and l.invoice_id=f.id where f.status='confirmada' group by f.status,f.document_type order by f.document_type
